description: A symmetrical open shell: a scalloped upper valve with three rounded lobes and two short inner ridge lines arches over a shallow bowl-shaped lower valve. A round pearl sits at the centre on the lower valve's rim.

concept: Rabbit in a Magic Top Hat
description: A rabbit's head with two tall upright oval ears and two oval eyes peeks out of a top hat. The hat is a slightly tapering crown below a straight horizontal brim that crosses the rabbit's face beneath its eyes.
